name: niri
summary: niri generally forbids LLM-created content and requires pull request code and tests, issue descriptions, comments, and public reviews to be human-written. Private LLM use is allowed except for writing from scratch, and LLMs may translate a contributor's own text only if the original text is also provided.

evidence.quote: You're not allowed to use LLMs to *create*.
All pull request code (including tests), issue descriptions, comments, public reviews, etc. must be human-written.
You can use LLMs privately (not like I can check or control that), but not to write from scratch.
